profile_panels.note: Required Cartesian velocity profiles on the extrados at x/c = 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, and 0.95. One R2 is calculated for each of the eight station/quantity groups across the complete split, bounded to [0, 1], and averaged equally into the overall profile score. The complete extraction contract is pinned by profile_definition.
